display_title: Eureka-cluster ITEA voor innovatie in software en systemen – Eureka-cluster ITEA
call_title: Eureka-cluster ITEA voor innovatie in software en systemen
executive_summary: National co-funding by RVO for Dutch partners in international ITEA projects (an Eureka cluster for market-oriented R&D on software-intensive systems and services), with partners from at least two countries. The Dutch budget is EUR 10 million, with at most EUR 4 million per project and rates of 25% to 50% depending on organisation type and research or development work. The international Project Outline deadline was 2 November 2026; invited consortia submit the Full Project Proposal by 11 February 2027, and the national application is expected in April 2027.
status_rationale: The RVO ITEA page (Voor wie?, Voorwaarden) and RNES title 3.8 fund market-oriented R&D on software-intensive systems and services in any application area, which allows energy-system software such as the grid models and digital twins of Digital Twin Programme, GNN4GC and TenneTwin. RNES article 3.8.2 funds each participant in an ITEA-labelled consortium with at least one company established in the Netherlands, at 35% (industrial research) or 25% (experimental development) for a large company, so TenneT TSO B.V. could be a funded partner (C1.3); article 3.8.9 excludes applications from government bodies, which on our reading does not cover TenneT TSO B.V. as a private-law company. Only consortia that submitted a Project Outline by 2 November 2026 can still reach the Full Project Proposal stage.
